articles.title: Top Performing Fund for July 2026 - AHAM New China Tracker Fund
articles.claim_summary: AHAM New China Tracker Fund, benchmarked to the S&P New China Sectors Ex A-Shares Index (Chinese consumption and services-oriented "new economy" companies, not old-economy/state-owned firms), was the top performing fund for July 2026, reflecting strong performance in China's new-economy consumer and services sector.

findings.title: BYD shares slide as fierce China competition dents first-half earnings - CNBC
findings.reason: The article reports that Chinese EV leader BYD experienced a 20.5% drop in first-half net profit to 12.3 billion yuan and a 7.1% revenue decline amid sluggish domestic demand and fierce competition, contradicting the claim of strong performance across China's consumer sector.

findings.title: China's factory activity shrinks for second straight month, contracting less than expected - CNBC
findings.reason: The article highlights that China's economic malaise deepened as consumer spending stalled, retail sales slowed in July, and economic growth slowed to 4.3% in the second quarter, undermining the claim of strong performance in China's consumer sector.

findings.title: China’s factory activity extends slump even as gauge rises - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The article states that consumer demand remains weak and the non-manufacturing activity gauge covering services and construction contracted to 49.0, complicating the claim of robust strength in China's consumer and services sectors.

findings.title: Shein CEO’s wealth slumps US$15 bil after whittled-down IPO - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The report notes that Chinese consumer brands have faced diminished investor interest as e-commerce became less attractive, with Shein's valuation dropping to around a quarter of its US$100 billion peak and shares of consumer IPOs like Eastroc Beverage and Muyuan Foods trading below listing prices.
